name: Accelgor

attacks.name: Deck and Cover
attacks.text: Your opponent’s Active Pokémon is now Poisoned and Paralyzed. Shuffle this Pokémon and all attached cards into your deck.

flavor:
Discarding its shell made it nimble. To keep
itself from dehydrating, it wraps its body in
bands of membrane.
